g.text: The draw: lottery order and snake draft
A pure module (shared/draw/) plans the draw. The server and the browser replay run the same code, so they cannot disagree.
Everyone gets one week before anyone gets a second.
together only: the first week all siblings ranked with a seat for EACH of them
in their age group, or none of them
together preferred: together if possible, otherwise one by one
independent (and single children): the highest-ranked week with a free seat
Plan: one step per atomic commit
Commit each step as ONE transaction
Submission time is not an input. Round 1 is strategy-proof: ranking your true favourite first never hurts. Later rounds are not fully strategy-proof, which
